paragraphs: AI: "Anthropic Should Delay IPO to Address AI Safety Risks, Says NYC Comptroller" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Florida teen used AI-altered photo to frame ex-boyfriend in school shooting threat, deputies say" (CBS News).

Political: "Press secretary Katie Zacharia tries to defend shaky first briefing: ‘I woke up at 3 in the morning’" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Live updates: Trump returns to deep-red South with Georgia visit; Zacharia faces scrutiny" (The Hill).

Economic: "Warsh Vows to Tame Inflation as A.I. Delivers ‘Shock’ to Economy" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "US Factory Production Rebounds on Semiconductors, Supplies" (Bloomberg).

Financial: "Congo Arrests Hundreds of Chinese Miners in Copper Heartland" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Lufthansa’s Final A346 Flight Marks the End of an Aviation Love Story" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "Japan Mistakenly Issues Warning for Strongest Ever Earthquake" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Patients in chains rescued from suspected illegal rehab centre in South Africa" (BBC News).
